session.authenticate: Opens the session. A signed-in call cannot send it; the gateway answers already_authenticated.
attachment.write: One piece of an upload's bytes for a surface that cannot reach PUT /attachments. The action is attachment.begin; the bytes are not a JSON call.
conversation.subscribe: Follows one conversation by a stream of events after the acknowledgement. One call would drop the stream.
conversation.subscribeList: Follows the conversation list by a stream of events after the acknowledgement. One call would drop the stream.
conversation.subscribeEvents: Follows one conversation's events by a stream after the acknowledgement. One call would drop the stream.
agents.subscribe: Follows the agent catalog by a stream of events after the acknowledgement. One call would drop the stream.
